lines: Trend Classification: DECLINING. BECU's net income declined from $207M (2024) to an estimated $173M (2025), making it the only top-5 US credit union to report lower earnings year-over-year. Total assets remain stable at $29.4B. The SAFE Credit Union merger, announced November 2025, will create a combined entity exceeding $33B in assets with 2M+ members — a strategic response to margin compression and the need for scale. Jefferies LLC serves as financial advisor. The merger is expected to close in early 2027 pending regulatory approval. [E-002, E-003, E-051]

firmographics.narrative_md: Boeing Employees Credit Union (BECU) is a member-owned, not-for-profit financial cooperative organized under Washington state law. Founded in 1935 by 18 Boeing employees as Fellowship Credit Union, BECU has grown to become the 4th largest credit union in the United States and the largest in Washington state. Headquartered at 12770 Gateway Drive, Tukwila, WA 98168, BECU operates as a cooperative where each of its 1.6 million members holds equal ownership. The institution is governed by a volunteer Board of Directors elected by members. [E-001, E-002, E-003]

narrative.issue_register_md:
Severity-Capped Capability Impact Analysis
ISS-001 (CFPB +172%): Caps Omnichannel Service and Compliance at level 3. Without cap, raw scores would be 2.8-3.0. The 0.4-0.6 point reduction represents the gap between structural capability (channels exist, programs exist) and outcome quality (complaints rising, resolution low). [E-069]
ISS-003 (Glassdoor 3.1): Caps all Culture subcaps at level 3. This is the single most impactful cap in the assessment, affecting 41 subcaps. Despite formal structures (ERGs, VP DEI, BILD initiative, agile VPs), the 43% recommend rate indicates execution has not matched intent. [E-046, E-050]
ISS-005 (SAFE merger + no iPaaS): Caps Integration Architecture and Resilience at level 3. The absence of an integration platform is not merely a missing tool — it represents an architectural gap that will multiply with every system the SAFE merger brings. [E-051, E-103]
